4624: Riki is the protagonist of Little Busters! He is a member of the Little Busters, and of them, he is seen as the only one that is straightforward and has common sense. His parents died when he was very young, and around the same time he was diagnosed with narcolepsy.
4626: Komari is very childish, taking great interest in fairy-tales, picture books, candy, and clothing with many layers of frills. She is very clumsy, and will often not think before she acts.
4627: Haruka is a schoolmate of Riki from a different class, but despite this, always seems to find time to hang around in Riki's classroom.
4628: Kudryavka, also known as "Kud" for short, is a girl who is a quarter Japanese, and three-quarters Russian. Her grandfather was Japanese, and per his influence on her, she came to know much about the Japanese culture, including the language. She is very bad in English, though.
4629: Yuiko is Riki's classmate who has a self-sufficient personality. She is sometimes seen carrying a replica of a katana. She is seen as an older sister to everyone despite being the same age of almost the entire cast, and is referred to as Anego (姉御, "elder sister") by Haruka.
4630: Mio is a calm and shy girl who is very diligent. Due to having weak health, she is always seen with a parasol when outside. She enjoys reading, especially when the story contains boys love elements, and her room is filled with books.
4631: Kyousuke is the leader of the Little Busters, and is one year older than the other four members. He often comes up with absurd ideas, but almost always, he follows up with a reasonable explanation along with it. He suffers from a lolita complex, though he denies it.
4632: Masato is a member of the Little Busters, and is Riki's roommate. He loves to work out and improve his muscle mass. His rival is Kengo Miyazawa, fellow member of the Little Busters.
4633: Kengo is a member of the Little Busters. He is skilled in the art of kendo and has a cynical personality, but his passion for the Little Busters is unmatched by anyone.
4634: Kanata is a girl at Riki's school and is the public morals chairman. She is often seen chasing after Haruka, who is a well-known trouble maker.
4635: Sasami is a girl at Riki's school and is Rin's rival. While Rin loves cats, Sasami is a devoted dog lover.
4636: Koshiki Miyuki comes from a family of well-known archers. She was known as a prodigy, and there were really high hopes for her. But then an illness took her eyesight.
13039: Rin is the main heroine in the story. She is the younger sister of Kyousuke Natsume and is the only female member out of the five original members of the Little Busters. She does not communicate well and is seen as inarticulate.
72747: Rei Kawagoe is one of the three followers of Sasami Sasasegawa; the other two being Watanabe Sakiko and Yukari Nakamura. She is a first year student and part of the softball club.
72749: Yukari Nakamura is one of the three followers of Sasami Sasasegawa; the other two being Watanabe Sakiko and Rei Kawagoe. She is a first year student and part of the softball club.
74545: The previous head of the girl's dormitory. A-chan is the president of the home economics club, which Kudryavka is a member of, and she likes interesting and strange things.
80485: A cheerful girl who seems like the polar opposite of the quiet Mio.
253762: One of Rin's fifteen cats. He is a very fat cat with tiny paws, although there is some discrepancy on how large he actually is. He weighs 39 kilograms, making him more heavier than Kudryavka Noumi. In the Little Busters VN, Rin can use him as a weapon in the Battle minigame.
